Class GameDTO

java.lang.Object
app.model.multi.GameDTO
public class GameDTO extends Object
A data transfer object (DTO) for managing operations related to a game. This class provides static utility methods to initialize game components such as decks and players, and to handle actions like drawing and playing cards.

  • Method Details

    • initDeck

      public static void initDeck(String data, Deck deck)
      Initializes a deck of cards based on the given data string. Each card is specified as a combination of a suit and a rank, separated by a colon. The cards are separated by spaces in the data string. Each parsed card is added to the provided deck.
      Parameters:
      data - the string containing card data in the format "suit:rank suit:rank ..."
      deck - the Deck object to which the parsed cards will be added

    • initPlayers

      public static void initPlayers(String data, List<Player> players, List<Player> users)
      Initializes players based on the given data string. Each player is specified as a combination of an id and an icon, separated by a colon. The players are separated by spaces in the data string. Each parsed player is added to the provided players and users lists.
      Parameters:
      data - the string containing player data in the format "id:icon id:icon ..."
      players - the list to which all parsed players will be added
      users - the list to which all parsed players will be added (same as players)

    • createPlayers

      public static void createPlayers(String data, List<Player> players)
      Parses player data from the provided string and adds the players to the given list. Each player is specified using an id and an icon, separated by a colon. The players are separated by spaces in the data string. If a player with the same id already exists in the list, it will not be added again.
      Parameters:
      data - the string containing player data in the format "id:icon id:icon ..."
      players - the list to which all parsed players will be added

    • drawCard

      public static javafx.util.Pair<Integer,Card> drawCard(String data)
      Parses the provided data string to extract an identifier and a card. The data string should be formatted as "id suit:rank", where: - id is an integer representing the identifier. - suit and rank represent the suit and rank of the card respectively.
      Parameters:
      data - the string containing the card data in the format "id suit:rank".
      Returns:
      a Pair containing the identifier as an Integer and the parsed Card object.

    • putDummy

      public static Card putDummy(String data)
      Parses the provided data string to extract card information and creates a Card object. The input string should be formatted as "suit:rank", where: - suit is an integer representing the suit of the card. - rank is an integer representing the rank of the card.
      Parameters:
      data - the string containing the card data in the format "suit:rank".
      Returns:
      a Card object created based on the parsed suit and rank.
